opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels and Viator tours, then record a summary note with prices.
steps: Google Flights: set origin, destination, pick departure and return dates, search
Booking.com: enter destination, select dates, search, open top hotel and note price
Viator: search '<attraction> tour <city>', open top result and note price
Open notes, type 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...' and press Enter

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3-7, easyJet 89, Room Roma Nazionale, Colosseum tour
Barcelona, Jan 20-24, Vueling-Iberia 113, IBIS Budget Barcelona Center, Sagrada Familia tour
